NOTICE OF THE ANNUAL GENERAL MEETING OF SASOL LIMITED


Notice is hereby given that Sasol’s Annual General Meeting (AGM) will be held electronically via
Sasol’s electronic meeting platform at 09:00 on Friday, 13 November 2026, to transact the business
stated in the notice of AGM. The information pertaining to the AGM is as follows:


Issuer name Sasol Limited


Type of instrument Ordinary shares


ISIN number ZAE000006896


JSE code SOL


ISIN number ZAE000151817


JSE code SOLBE1

Website link[www.sasol.com](http://www.sasol.com/)


DIRECTOR RETIRING BY ROTATION


In accordance with paragraph 6.71 of the JSE Limited Listings Requirements, shareholders are
advised that Ms Trix Kennealy will retire by rotation at the AGM and will not offer herself for
re-election as a non-executive director of the Company at the AGM to be held on 13 November 2026,
having served on the Board since 1 March 2017. Consequently, Ms Kennealy will also retire as chairman
and member of the Audit Committee, member of the Nomination and Governance Committee and member
of the Capital Investment Committee.


The Board extends its deep appreciation to Ms Kennealy for her exemplary service since joining the
Board. Over the past decade, she has served Sasol with distinction, utmost professionalism and
unwavering commitment, providing valuable counsel and insight to the Board. Her contribution to the
Company has been significant and enduring, and she leaves with the Board's sincere thanks and best
wishes for the future.


15 October 2026
Sandton
